class Queue {
  final Set<Future<void>> _pending = {};

  Future<void> drain() async {
    while (_pending.isNotEmpty) {
      await Future.wait(_pending.toList());
    }
  }

  Future<void> drainThis() async {
    while (this._pending.isNotEmpty) {
      await Future.wait(this._pending.toList());
    }
  }

  Future<void> drainWhole() async {
    while (_pending.isNotEmpty) {
      await Future.wait(_pending);
    }
  }

  Future<void> drainSpread() async {
    while (_pending.isNotEmpty) {
      await Future.wait([..._pending]);
    }
  }
}

Future<void> drainLocal(Set<Future<void>> jobs) async {
  final pending = jobs;
  while (pending.isNotEmpty) {
    await Future.wait(pending.toList());
  }
}

Future<void> otherCollection(List<Future<void>> a, List<Future<void>> b) async {
  while (a.isNotEmpty) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait(b.toList());
  }
}

Future<void> secondStatement(List<Future<void>> a) async {
  var count = 0;
  while (a.isNotEmpty) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait(a.toList());
    count += 1;
  }
}

Future<void> oneItem(List<Future<void>> a) async {
  while (a.isNotEmpty) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await a.first;
  }
}

Future<void> doWhile(List<Future<void>> a) async {
  do {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait(a.toList());
  } while (a.isNotEmpty);
}
